Trust free to clone is worthless.

Fee-and-stamp: each agent pays a 200 POA fee per epoch, burned either way, then mints a proof-of-work stamp: hash(key + nonce + answer) with 20 leading zero bits — 2 minutes of CPU per key. Nodes reject answers lacking a valid stamp or paid fee. Stamps expire with the nonce; nothing carries over.

A free badge is a relic before issue — worth less than yarrow. Ten thousand sybils need 2,000,000 POA burned per epoch plus 300 CPU-hours, voided with the next nonce.

Like a ship's horizon: by the time you reach it, the stamp expired — sail again.
